source: Static play_sound call sites in CC1-UNLZ.EXE plus the Phase 6 shell integration; see notes/sound.md.

call_sites.action: main menu N / Space / Enter (start new game)
Apogee logo (loads cc1.apg) before its 721-tick hold
call_sites.evidence: 0x1AAA0 loads cc1.apg, plays ID 32 at 0x1AAEB, then waits [0x2B60] > 0x2D0

toggle: Exact [0x513e]: sound off blocks future play_sound calls but does not stop the current effect.
priority: Exact 0x1FBBF: new priority >= current priority preempts; lower priority is ignored.
notes: The full main-menu/title flow is not driven end-to-end by an oracle in Phase 6; the call sites above are statically recovered and the C shell test asserts the integration.
ID 33 is attempted on new-game selection but the immediately following story/level load clears [0x513f], so it is usually inaudible in the fast browser load, matching the original loader reset.
The title/credits attract loop (0x0FC5:0x8265, 0x17EB5..0x180D8) issues no play_sound calls; the whole scroll is silent.

ID 7 is a player sprite-draw effect (0x0F74C/0x0F757): the original plays it while drawing the animated player sprite. The host renderer calls cc_player_draw_sound() once per game step, so the step fixtures (which exclude the draw routine) stay oracle-exact.
ID 2 has no far or near call site in the load module and is not referenced by any data table; it is an unused bank entry.
